## Findings
- [ ] **[BLOCK][Coverage] Release lowers statement coverage by 3.2pp**
  - **Status quo:** total 60.1% at v0.3.0 → 56.9% at HEAD; new code from PR #50 is the source: `internal/ai/anthropic.go:14` `streamAnthropic` 0.0%, `internal/secrets/secrets.go:18` `ResolveKey` 31.6%, `Source` 54.5%.
  - **Likely cause:** Cloud-provider streaming path and symvault/fallback key-resolution branches shipped without tests (no httptest server for the Anthropic client, no PATH-manipulation tests for symvault resolution).
  - **Proposed solution:** Add streaming-client tests against a local httptest server and secrets-resolution tests for both PATH states, mirroring the existing `internal/compose` test matrix.
  - **Handoff:** `/test-coverage` → `/02-gh-plan --from-coverage <path>` → `/03-gh-go`
- [ ] **[BLOCK][Docs] README predates the shipped composition and AI capabilities**
  - **Status quo:** `README.md:10` claims only `symingest` is composed "today" and lists `symseek`/`symmemory`/`symvault` as "planned" — but symseek/symmemory compose since PR #41 (v0.3.0) and symvault-backed secrets + Anthropic provider since PR #50; the "AI (optional, local-first)" section documents Ollama only. README last touched at v0.2.0 (`5bec86b`).
  - **Likely cause:** Two releases shipped without a README pass.
  - **Proposed solution:** Update the composition table (today: symingest, symseek, symmemory, symvault) and document cloud-provider configuration (key via symvault `op://` reference / Keychain fallback) alongside Ollama.
  - **Handoff:** `/03-gh-go` (doc issue) or fix within the release PR before re-running the gate
